items.title: Your Claude account by its email
items.text: Claude plan usage shows the verified email of the account it measures, loaded without holding the usage view open.

items.title: Choose your Claude model
items.text: A Claude subscription can use Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5 or Haiku 4.5, or the latest Opus, Sonnet and Haiku; a new Claude connection starts on Opus 5.5.

items.title: A new window
items.text: Branch has a new window: places down the side, the conversation in the middle, and everything the engine cannot do yet shown greyed out rather than hidden.

items.title: One place for what needs you
items.text: Questions a Trunk is waiting on, tasks that can be picked up again, and a record you can check, all in the Inbox.

items.title: A board for longer work
items.text: Automations has a task board, a record of how each one is doing, and a way to carry on a task Branch closed on.

items.title: Connectors and your own servers
items.text: A catalogue of well-known connectors, and your own servers kept between restarts. A server that starts a program on this computer is added switched off, and starting it waits for your yes.

items.title: Command-line tools on this computer
items.text: Branch finds the command-line tools installed here without running them. Allow one and Trunks may use it; every command still asks first unless your approval settings say otherwise.

items.title: Learn an app, and prove it
items.text: Branch writes what an app must do and checks each point on the real thing.

items.title: Setup and the walkthrough
items.text: Setup step by step, then a tour of every part.

items.title: Agents with a body
items.text: Original characters that move by what they are doing. Pick one per Trunk.

items.title: Chat apps
items.text: Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord and more, each with its own setup.

items.title: Models on this computer
items.text: A hardware check and one-click local models that fit it.

items.title: Account services
items.text: Plans, coding assistants, keys, local and your own.

items.title: Pets and painted scenes
items.text: Pets that walk and nap, and painted scenes behind the glass.

items.title: Pins, rewind and a look inside
items.text: Pin a message so it stays in front of the assistant, go back to an earlier message and try again, and look inside any answer to see what ran.

items.title: Memory that stays tidy
items.text: See what is remembered, tidy up facts said twice, and export or archive what you want to keep.

items.title: Shortcuts you set
items.text: Press the keys you want for the actions you use most.

items.title: Release notes
items.text: What this version has, and what the next one adds.
